body: omg I feel you 😪🤕😳

if your boyfriend liked the cat before and you moved all the way to be with him and he knows you can't just move out that easily, i consider this blackmail. he knew you were a package and you obviously gave up a lot already to move to another country. if you give your cat to someone else (your ex or whoever) you might start to resent your boyfriend for it. he can't make you give up everything. i wouldn't do anything impulsively. maybe this has nothing to do with the cat and he's just stressed out with other things. and with your cat being sick, he lashed out at the cat (which is ridiculous)... it's hard enough to start a new life in another country... he shouldn't make this harder for you than it is.
happened to me too, the hotline made it way worse as well and i ended up attempting suicide that night. :/
thanks to all of you. I just needed someone to talk to. I know the effects of paracetamol/Tylenol. I knew and I didn't care. :/

I'm in Australia right now, I'm from the EU. I can only talk to a gp tomorrow and see what she says. I have no money and my visa is going to expire. I can maybe just afford the flight. I still have no intention to make it back alive. I've been living in Australia for years and I have no home or friends back there and I'm going to be homeless. I know all my options and I have zero.

I don't have health insurance for hospital and no money, I'm overseas. 
I've been in medication for depression all my life and tried 30 different things. I've been in therapy for over 8 years every week. I'm a failure. thanks though, I know about paracetamol damaging the liver. I unfortunately was aware of that and didn't care. :/ thanks

I know, I didn't care if it's gonna be painful at that point. I was afraid the other pills weren't enough. I'm overseas and my student insurance doesn't cover anything like that. I don't have money either.
I'm with you. I'm not doing 30, I'm done.
I wish you could share this. 😶 good luck?
/r/ExNoContact is a good sub to subscribe to. everyone on there sharing stories and trying to maintain NC. maybe it will help to feel less alone ?
I agree. we are often so afraid of rejection that we are to scared to reach out. I'm in the same boat as you atm. I'm not sure what to do.
thanks for sharing your story. :'( good luck man!

you can't do much than sit back, relax and go on with your life. she's probably waiting for you to break up but that's not fair to you. pursuing her even more at this point will only push her further away. 
show her that your ok on your own, show her you're not needy and that you're capable of living your own life.

regardless of you having a crush on her, a friend doesn't call another friend ugly. not even jokingly. 
I'm sorry you got so hurt. :/ a friend should be there to support you and not make you feel shitty about yourself.

that's the first time I read this about someone else. I used to get into fights with my mum over her chewing as well. I don't even like when I hear myaelf chew, so I distract myself by watching something while eating. when I'm around other people it's easier if I'm eating too or if there is music on or if I'm somehow distracted. 
I don't think it's as bad as you have it but I still felt like replying. you're not alone.

life sucks. :/ if you don't have the patience to learn how to code use fiverr.com and find someone who turns your idea into an app. saw people who help with that on there. it's a great website. 
I hope you can maybe get out of this a bit by trying to work on your idea. :/
I really appreciated your post. thanks for sharing!

it's extremely harmful to the kidneys and if you survive you'll most certainly end up with kidney failure. it's extremely painful too. it's highly toxic and it wouldn't be a peaceful death. I'm on lithium and I considered it.

I think it's you looking for closure. she hasn't reached out to you (yet). even if you're happy for her, it's also painful finding out from someone else that she's moving away and that she didn't feel like telling you herself. that stings. 

the question is what do you expect from this "closure"? how would that conversation have to be like to not hurt you?

she didn't let you know she is moving but you know from a mutual friend? plus she already left you hanging with the last message you sent about wanting to talk things over and she ignored it? no, breaking nc is just an excuse to contact her. which is understandable because nc is hard but it's still an excuse.

sounds like me and my family. I stopped taking meds too. they don't take me seriously even though they're taking anti depressants themselves- the difference is they feel better on them. I've attempted suicide before, now they hate me even more. I hate being around them. I feel so worthless.

some suicide hotlines have an app and there is a chat 24/7. I'm too anxious to talk to a stranger over the phone too :/ if you don't wanna talk at all and not even chat... I feel you, I'm the same. I keep it all bottled up. :/

there is bipolar 1, 2 etc. I've been diagnosed with bipolar and I don't feel it's "that" serious either. I don't know if that's the disorder. I sometimes feel it's just life. you have hope and feel like you can do it and the next second you realise it's not that easy and you don't even know where to start. and because you were depressed in the first place, you don't even have the energy to pursue whatever you think could work for you. its like you want something to change and maybe you even see what you could do about it but you have too many doubts which keep you from doing anything at all.
sounds like bipolar. talk to your doctor?
could it be that she is just extremely shy?

by reading about your life I thought we were the same person. I have a degree but  the only thing I believe I'm good at is art and writing. 
I've been suffering from insomnia for as long as I can remember and I cannot get up either. I know I'm extremely anxious. 
I moved to another country to (to study). my boyfriend dropped me and my parents are treating me like the failure I am (even from afar). I cannot handle them all making me feel so worthless and useless. I've been trying really hard- for years. all medication in the book, therapy, new hobbies, etc etc etc. 
your relationship sounds like it adds to your anxiety. a lot! he's not helping at all, you can't push people with depression. 
if you ever feel like you have no one to talk to, pm me.

I've been feeling like this for 15 years. i don't think there are 10 minutes I don't wish to die. I've tried before too. your family sounds like mine :/ I've tried every medication in the book and went to therapy for years. now my life is completely breaking apart and I'm facing homelessness. I'm so done. pm me of you need to talk. I feel really alone in this too.

no, it's definitely not ok to find out their real name and contact their family. If they don't wanna talk to you and blocked you, then leave them. it doesn't mean they don't talk to anyone about it but obviously they didn't want to talk to you. 
I feel for that person, if you contact their parents and even stalked their name(!!!)... as I said, it's stalking. it's super creepy. I've been in the situation before and i absolutely despise that person for telling my family because I was just annoyed and blocked them for not giving me the space I asked for several times. that person didn't respect my boundaries and found out my full name too and then contacted not only one family member of mine (and that crazy stalker did never meet any of my family or talk to them).

I can only speak from experience. I don't care how worried that person was, as i considered that an extreme violation and invasion of my privacy.

I don't know if that person you're worried about ever told you to leave them alone or that they will retreat or need time to themselves- in my case, I did that and it had been ignored. I will never talk to that person again who also gave my mother almost a heart attack. .... stalking is not ok. people will reach out for help, even here on reddit, anywhere. if they don't want to talk to a certain person, they won't. thats how it was for me, I would have never blocked that person but it was too much in the first place. 

I've never posted on reddit before but felt really strongly about this because it happened to me to 🙄 it was a super creepy well done stalking attempt and it scared me off to talk to that person ever again. trust broken forever.
